dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped light-colored perimeters with wavy, non-linear boundaries. High-contrast gradient transition from dark exterior pixels to light perimeter, followed by a transition to a darker interior basin.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters lacking internal gradients, primarily distributed in the anterior dorsal region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three dominant dorsal macro-annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle. Inclusion of a secondary high-intensity blob in the lower lateral region extends this into an irregular quadrilateral geometry.
